verdicts.why: LK202: Sylvie agrees to help stop Dox; while Loki distracts the loyalists, Mobius and Sylvie destroy the TemPads setting off the reset charges.

LK203: Renslayer gets Timely away from the fair while Loki and Mobius pursue; at the Wisconsin lab Mobius pleads with her to hand Timely over, Sylvie takes control, Loki leaves with Timely and Renslayer is left with Sylvie.

value.title: Daredevil S1#13
value.text: At Ben Urich's funeral, Karen glares at Ellison, convinced he took Fisk's money and got Ben killed.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's editor, whom Karen blames for his death.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's friend, who blames Ellison for his death.

verdicts.why: At Ben's funeral (DD113) Karen stares accusingly at Ellison, who notices, believing he took Fisk's money and got Ben killed; DD205 confirms the moment when she apologizes for how she treated him there. A scene together with a charged exchange that shows they know each other.
TP110: Mahoney's unit blocks the kitchen exit, Karen walks out with Frank behind her, Mahoney orders his men to hold fire and Frank escapes via the elevator.
TP110: Mahoney interviews Karen, who insists Frank was looking out for her and is not a terrorist; he notes she could be arrested but accepts she is likely telling the truth.

TP103 Kandahar flashback: Castle warns the mission is a trap, Schoonover sides with Rawlins and orders the unit out; Schoonover loses an arm in the ambush and Castle takes command and saves the unit. Real flashback, enemy kind carried from DD S2#12.
TP113 real flashback: Frank takes Maria and the children to Central Park for a picnic, Lisa on the carousel, the day of the massacre.
TP109: Ellison is called to Karen's office over the bomber's letter, insists they go to the FBI and only print an editorial with FBI permission, then storms in asking if she knew Castle was alive.

DD311: Foggy surrenders Karen to the NYPD, Mahoney takes her under state law over Poindexter's objection, drives Foggy and Karen away, frees her and promises every cop will have their back against Fisk.
DD311: Mahoney arrests Karen to keep her from Fisk's FBI agents at Nadeem's request, then takes off her handcuffs and lets her go.
DD312: Matt, Foggy and Mahoney bring Nadeem's family to Bess Mahoney's house; Nelson and Murdock recruit Mahoney to pull over Blake Tower to talk about Nadeem's testimony.
DD303-304: Foggy and Marci are living together; she advises him to stand up to Fisk and suggests he run for DA against Tower.
DD S3 #9: Fisk's fixer Manning threatens Foggy's family unless he publicly apologizes for speaking out against Fisk at the debate.
DD309 real flashback (Jack's house, baby Matt credited): Jack meets the young nun Maggie, they fall in love and have Matt, and she returns to her order, leaving Jack alone with their son.
TP211: Mahoney stops Karen in the hospital without shoes; she says she gave them to a worthy cause, which he takes to mean she helped Castle escape.
TP208: Hoyle takes out the sniper in the shootout with Russo's gang; when Mahoney corners Castle, Hoyle fires a shot inches from Mahoney's head and the two get away.
TP202 Madani turns down Castle's call; TP203 she arrives in a helicopter as Pilgrim's mercenaries attack the Larkville station and takes Castle to help deal with Russo.
TP202: Madani is reprimanded by her mentor Hernandez for continuing to visit Russo and told to stay away from him.
TP211: Karen visits Castle in the hospital, she and Madani learn Russo executed the three women, and Karen sets off the fire alarms as cover for his escape.
TP205: Castle coerces Turk into setting up a meeting with Konchevsky; the Russians make Turk set up an ambush for Castle instead.

value.title: The Daily Bugle#17
value.text: Betty sits down with Peter for a Bugle interview and asks what he would say to the spider that bit him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Betty interviews for the Bugle.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who interviews Peter for the Bugle.

verdicts.why: In #8 Peter is only talked about (no exchange). In #17 Betty does a sit-down interview with Peter himself (Peter credited as new TikTok cast, not archive), asking what he would say to the spider that bit him. That is their real exchange in the series.
In #13 Flash only talks about Peter in Betty's interview; Peter is not in it, and no Daily Bugle video shows Flash and Peter dealing with each other. A mention is not a stage.

In #4 Peter appears only in Mysterio's recorded video that Jameson airs; the two never exchange anything in the series (Jameson's 'Last Word' segments are separate from Peter's interview). A recording is not a stage.
Wanda does not appear in Agatha All Along#1; the spell is from WandaVision and she is only referred to (Rio's line, the red-haired corpse). A mention is not a stage.
In #6 Wanda is voice only and Billy learns of her from Ralph Bohner; there is no exchange between them, only her Hex collapsing and a mention.

In the mid-credits scene the bangle swaps Kamala out and Carol appears alone in Kamala's bedroom; they never see, speak to or act toward each other in Ms. Marvel, and Kamala's fandom is knowing about Carol.

In MZ104 the zombie Hawkeye is cut down by the London Master's energy slashes, not by Peter; Peter and Lang fight the zombie Wasp. Peter has no exchange with the Zombie Avengers there, so it stays a shared battle (Kamala's MZ#4 stage says 'the heroes' cut him down, which the source credits to the London Master).
JJ203: Foggy hand-delivers Benowitz and Chao's buyout proposal and wants to help Jeri fight it; she angrily tells him off.
JJ203: Jeri reveals her ALS to Jessica and asks her to find leverage on her partners pushing her out; Jessica agrees.

value.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law#2
value.text: Bruce tells Jen that Blonsky sent him a haiku from prison and the two made up, so he is fine with her taking Blonsky's parole case.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An old enemy who writes from prison to make amends.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An old foe Blonsky makes amends with by letter.

verdicts.why: In 'Superhuman Law' Bruce and Blonsky are not on screen together; Bruce tells Jen on the phone that Blonsky sent him a haiku a while back and they made up, and okays her taking the case. The amends happen before the title, so the text should say what is told there.
IF S2 #5: Wing and Knight track Walker, find the wounded Rand, then overpower Walker and take her and Joy to the dojo.
IAG105: Groot takes Drax's soap for his Guardians portrait; Drax (non-speaking) finds it missing and searches for it, and Rocket notes Drax has been looking everywhere for it.
AC210: at Stark's studio lot Thompson works the rift trap with the team; Stark shoots Frost with the gamma cannon he built and Thompson apprehends her.
AC S2 #3: Carter enlists Stark to investigate the Arena Club; investigating a gravitational anomaly around her, Stark finds Wilkes is alive but invisible.

value.title: Hawkeye#5
value.text: Yelena and fellow freed Widow Sonya, who are helping deprogrammed Widows, reunite with another former Widow, Ana.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A freed Widow who helps the others after deprogramming.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow Widows Yelena helps after their deprogramming.

verdicts.why: Event is right (Hawkeye #5: Yelena and Sonya, helping deprogrammed Widows, reunite with Ana), but the card lines are swapped: a is The Widows, so the line on a's card must describe Yelena, and the line on Yelena's card must describe the Widows.
